g.title: crate A playable Kivact tutorial: shared PCM drives audio, waveform and spectrum.
crate::analysis Display data calculated from the exact PCM sent to the audio device.
crate::audio PCM shared by playback and visual analysis.
crate::components::app Root component of the music player, which owns the player and frame loop.
crate::components::cover Album art of the music player: embedded SVGs cropped to a square.
crate::components::spectrum 64-band spectrum of the PCM around the playback position.
crate::components::transport File loading and the transport buttons.
crate::components::waveform Full-track waveform with a playback cursor.
crate::player_state Player state shared through context.
crate::waveform_index Precomputed waveform bounds over shared PCM samples.
